1.web: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.
1.asv: But concerning the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that aught be written unto you.

2.web: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.
2.asv: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

3.web: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman; and they will in no way escape.
3.asv: When they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall in no wise escape.

4.web: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.
4.asv: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief:

5.web: You are all children of light, and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,
5.asv: for ye are all sons of light, and sons of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness;

6.web: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.
6.asv: so then let us not sleep, as do the rest, but let us watch and be sober.

7.web: For those who sleep, sleep in the night, and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.
7.asv: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that are drunken are drunken in the night.

8.web: But let us, since we belong to the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and, for a helmet, the hope of salvation.
8.asv: But let us, since we are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

9.web: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
9.asv: For God appointed us not unto wrath, but unto the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

10.web: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
10.asv: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

11.web: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
11.asv: Wherefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as also ye do.

12.web: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you,
12.asv: But we beseech you, brethren, to know them that labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

13.web: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.
13.asv: and to esteem them exceeding highly in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

14.web: We exhort you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, encourage the faint-hearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.
14.asv: And we exhort you, brethren, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be longsuffering toward all.

15.web: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good, for one another, and for all.
15.asv: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.

18.web: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
18.asv: in everything give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus to you-ward.

21.web: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
21.asv: prove all things; hold fast that which is good;

22.web: Abstain from every form of evil.
22.asv: abstain from every form of evil.

23.web: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
23.asv: And the God of peace himself sanctify you wholly; and may your spirit and soul and body be preserved entire, without blame at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

24.web: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
24.asv: Faithful is he that calleth you, who will also do it.

26.web: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.
26.asv: Salute all the brethren with a holy kiss.

27.web: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.
27.asv: I adjure you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the brethren.

28.web: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
28.asv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
